purpose: Transparent PS2-style botanical sprites; web exports resized with alpha preserved.

prompts.name: rose
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent web sprite for a designer portfolio. Style: early PlayStation 2 botanical game inventory render, low-poly 3D with visibly low-resolution nearest-neighbor textures, dithered shading, slightly soft nostalgic highlights, natural believable anatomy, muted natural colors. This must look like a 2001 game-rendered specimen, NOT a vector icon, emoji, smooth modern 3D toy or hand drawn cartoon. Truly transparent background, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside subject, no frame, no text, no pedestal. Entire subject fully within canvas, generous 8% transparent border; only ONE isolated specimen.
Subject: One slender white rose flower on a full green stem with two side branches, small green buds and angular leaves. Upright slightly leaning, bloom at top, bottom stem visible. Ivory petals with a pale green base. Portrait composition.
